title: EventEnvelope
description: Fact envelope per docs/architecture/event-contracts.md §7. event_id is stable across redeliveries (identity of the fact, not the delivery) — the key asymmetry vs the command envelope's message_id.

event_id.description: Identity of the fact. Stable across redeliveries — a producer that regenerates this for a retry is a defect.

event_type.description: One of the 36 names fixed by event-contracts.md §12 — no others exist. Adding one is an architecture change (context.md amendment), not an application change.

schema_version.description: MAJOR.MINOR of this event_type's payload schema, independent of API version and IR version.

occurred_at.description: The producing transaction's commit time, not publish time.

causation_id.description: message_id of the command that produced this fact, or event_id of a triggering event.

book_version_id.description: Present on every event about book content.

job_id.description: Absent for facts produced synchronously (e.g. voice.approved).

traceparent.description: W3C trace-context string. SHOULD be present, not required.

payload.description: Type-specific. Identifiers and small facts only — never bulk content.
